purpose: Pre-training source-feasibility gate for the standard 3-layer (E/M/H) tomography. Evaluated ONLY from frozen pi0 T1b measurements (difficulty_groups.*.v1.json); no post-treatment information used.

gate_definition.environment_validity: A(s)=1 iff the env seed initializes without UnStableError at env.setup_demo(). The 0-of-8-evaluated pattern is treated as a structural, seed-determined event (initialization validity), NOT missing-at-random. Report P(A=1) alongside P_theta(success | A=1).

requirements.note: supported_hard = hard group minus the 0/8 unsupported tail; pi0 success-first self-generation has zero expected yield on 0/8 seeds, so only supported-hard seeds can source D_H. Thresholds frozen 2026-08-17 before any T1c acquisition or T1d training; U_H threshold set to 12 (not 20) because the maximum attainable under the frozen 240-seed census is bounded by the supported-hard count itself.

place_container_plate.verdict: PASS — proceed with T1c under protocol.t1.v1.1 group-balanced acquisition

dump_bin_bigbin.environment_validity: 112/240 (46.7%); all-or-nothing: 112 seeds 8/8 evaluated, 128 seeds 0/8 (UnStableError at setup, e.g. 'unstable objects: garbage, ...')
dump_bin_bigbin.failure_reason: medium_unique_env_seeds = 3 AND supported_hard_unique_env_seeds = 8; environment-seed-level ESS for D_M is bounded by 3 regardless of trajectory count, so the D_M (and D_H) columns of the T1d design matrix cannot be reliably excited (X^T X near-singular).
dump_bin_bigbin.verdict: FAIL — standard 9-point E/M/H tomography is NOT identifiable for dump_bin_bigbin under the frozen 240-seed census. T1b v1 measurement stays frozen; the 128 UnStableError seeds stay in the record; seeds are NOT swapped and the run is NOT redone.
dump_bin_bigbin.role_reassignment: dump_bin_bigbin becomes the support-degenerate stress task: evidence for theory target 2 (zero-support unidentifiability) and for the method's obligation to report non-identifiability instead of fabricating a transport matrix. Any future enlarged seed pool must be published as difficulty_groups.dump_bin_bigbin v1.1/v2; v1 is never overwritten.

replacement_task_rule: If a second standard development task is added to replace dump_bin, it must be selected ONLY on pre-treatment criteria: (a) environment validity P(A=1) from a pi0-era screen, and (b) pi0 difficulty coverage (medium >= 20, supported-hard >= 12 projected). No fine-tuning result may inform the choice (no outcome-based task selection).
